notes: Fixture markets for the stub prediction-market provider (EVENT_PROB_PROVIDER=stub).
These let the ingest pipeline, storage, valuation, and dashboard run end to end with no network access or credentials.
updated_ts is refreshed by whoever edits this file; the calibrator treats an old timestamp as stale and shifts weight to the prior, which is the intended behavior for an unmaintained fixture.

markets.question: Will the US impose tighter China semiconductor export restrictions before 2027?
markets.description: Resolves YES if new export control rules restricting advanced AI accelerator sales to China take effect before 2027-01-01.

markets.question: Will the Fed cut rates at or before the December 2026 FOMC meeting?
markets.description: Resolves YES if the target federal funds rate is lowered at any FOMC meeting in the second half of 2026.
